Artist's Description

Along the North Carolina coast a series of barrier Islands known as the Outer Banks just about completely block access to the mainland, presenting an intricate labyrinth of inlets, sounds, and hazards. As if that weren't enough, two opposite and opposing currents collide, the cold arctic south flowing Labrador Current and the north-flowing warm Gulf Current, resulting in rough waters and unpredictable currents. Shallow sandbars form, known as the Diamond Shoals, creating a minefield for marine navigators. The Outer Banks Visitors Bureau lists some three-thousand plus shipwrecks along the stretch of coast from Kitty Hawk to Ocracoke since records began!


About Mark VanDyke

I'm a Virginia-based landscape and macro photographer who's spent two decades moving through--and connecting myself with--the physical landscapes of the Southern Appalachian Mountains and the Carolina coastlines. I believe health is happiness, that time is the greatest asset, and that I'm best when outdoors, physically moving, exploring. I feel most alive when I'm actively engaging my senses, creatively connecting with the natural world. For me, mornings fit best. Less is often more. I believe still photographs move, inspire; that the practice of landscape photography should be unstructured and exploratory, like play. I believe in respecting place; that the landscape should be approached on quiet feet. I believe that relationship...

Shopping - Atlantic Beach, North Carolina

ShoppingGuide was updated: June 19, 2025

Despite its small size, the Atlantic Beach area will pleasantly surprise you with its wide variety of goods on offer. While the majority of shops are beach-themed, there are boutiques and craft stores as well. Souvenirs from your Atlantic Beach trip will be easy to find.


Island Traders

Island Traders is the go-to spot in Atlantic Beach for seasonal wardrobe updates and beach-friendly accessories. Known for its quality merchandise, this shop stocks popular brands like Keen, Chaco, Reef, TOMS, and more. Whether you’re looking for durable sandals, stylish footwear, or accessories to complete your coastal getaway, Island Traders has you covered.

ShoppingRead more →


Atlantic Beach Surf Shop

Atlantic Beach Surf Shop has been a cornerstone of the community since 1964, catering to generations of surfers and beach lovers. As North Carolina’s oldest and most iconic surf shop, AB Surf Shop is a must-visit for anyone hitting the waves or just soaking up the coastal vibe.

ShoppingRead more →


Morehead Plaza Shopping Center

The Morehead Plaza Shopping Center is a solid option for travelers looking to explore shopping outside of Atlantic Beach. Located just a short drive away, this plaza offers a variety of conveniences, including a grocery store, fast food options, and an assortment of retail shops.

ShoppingRead more →


Jacksonville Mall

Jacksonville Mall, located in nearby Jacksonville, provides a well-rounded shopping experience for visitors looking to browse a variety of retail options. The mall features a mix of department stores and specialty shops, making it a convenient destination for everything from fashion to electronics. With a range of dining options and ample parking, it’s an ideal spot for those looking for a larger shopping center outside of Atlantic Beach.

ShoppingRead more →


Neuse Sport Shop

Neuse Sport Shop in Kinston is a go-to spot for outdoor enthusiasts, especially those looking to gear up for fishing season. The shop is stocked with top-quality Shimano products, a wide range of live and frozen baits, and the latest fishing essentials like Fish Bites and Berkley Gulp. In addition to fishing gear, they offer a well-rounded selection of marine hardware and hunting equipment, making it a convenient stop for all your outdoor adventure needs.

ShoppingRead more →


Kites Unlimited & Bird Stuff

Kites Unlimited & Bird Stuff is the perfect stop for beach lovers looking to add some fun to their day. Specializing in high-quality kites, the shop offers a variety of sizes and styles, along with accessories like flags, windsocks, and feathers. If you're looking for a fun activity to enjoy on the beach, look no further than Kites Unlimited.

ShoppingRead more →
